title: Altadena Stables
specs: Facility includes arena, bull pen, riding trails, wash rack with warm water, and automatic fly system
Experienced trainers specializing in multiple disciplines including Huntseat, Western Horsemanship, and Resistance Free Training
Riders expected to arrive 30 minutes prior to lesson to groom and tack horse
Lessons and camps available for individuals and groups
includes: Use of horses and riding equipment
Horse care education including grooming and handling
Boarding includes bedding, nutrition, and daily stall cleaning
gap: Exact age minimum for summer camp not stated
blurb: Guests can take riding lessons for ages five to adult with individualized instruction emphasizing safety, horsemanship, and good sportsmanship. Summer camps provide educational and fun horsemanship experiences including grooming, riding, and horse care. The facility includes arenas, trails, and boarding with high quality feed and care.
extraNote: Summer camp deposit $300 non-refundable · Full payment for camp due by May 15th to guarantee enrollment
